title: Admin override + support tools for onboarding checklist (mark complete/reset, audit trail, permissions)
creator: Chloe Martin
project: Guided onboarding + First production launch checklist
description: Support/CS needs an admin override mechanism for onboarding checklist steps to unblock troubleshooting and reduce ticket churn. This includes the ability to mark steps complete or reset them, with an audit trail and a clear permissions model. This is explicitly requested in INT-3307 and is needed for Support macros/triage flows during cohort rollout.
content:
## Context
As we roll out the in-Console onboarding checklist, Support will increasingly use checklist state as the "source of truth" to guide customers. During dogfood and early cohorts we’ve already hit cases where:
- events arrive out of order and step state lags (see ENG-5866)
- a customer completes a step but telemetry is missing due to transient pipeline issues
- Support needs to unblock a customer while engineering investigates eventing

Support asked for the ability to reset or force-complete a step as a last resort (INT-3307; reinforced in #support thread 1739478025 and Support enablement emails).

## Goals
1) Provide a secure admin override API to:
- mark one or more checklist steps COMPLETE
- reset one or more steps back to NOT_STARTED (or IN_PROGRESS where applicable)
- add an operator note/reason

2) Create an immutable audit trail for all overrides with operator identity, timestamps, and reason.

3) Define and enforce a permissions model that is compatible with Redwood Console roles (Support / CS / internal admin) and does not allow broad tenant tampering.

4) Minimize risk of "papering over" real data issues by making overrides visible (who/when/why) and reversible.

## Non-goals
- A full-featured support console or customer-visible override controls
- Bulk override tooling across many tenants (keep scope small for MVP)
- Automated remediation suggestions (explicitly out of scope for MVP)

## Requirements
### Functional
- Override applies per tenant (workspace/org).
- Target is a checklist "step" (by stable step_id) and optionally a sub-step if we add those later.
- Supported actions:
  - set_step_state(step_id, COMPLETE)
  - reset_step(step_id)
  - reset_all_steps() for a tenant (restricted; only for internal admin)
- Operator must provide a freeform reason (min length 10 chars). Add optional ticket link (Jira/Linear) for traceability.
- Overrides must be monotonic-safe with event-driven updates:
  - an override should not permanently block future real events
  - subsequent valid events may re-complete steps after a reset
  - step state computation must account for overrides as a higher-priority source than derived state, but with clear precedence rules

### Permissions / RBAC
- Endpoints must require an elevated capability, not just general Console access.
- Proposed capabilities:
  - onboarding_checklist.override:write (Support Admin + Internal Admin)
  - onboarding_checklist.override:read (Support + CS + Internal Admin)
- Scope is tenant-bound: operator must be explicitly granted to act on the tenant (Support impersonation / internal support context).
- All access must be logged.

### Audit trail
- Every override writes an append-only audit record:
  - audit_id
  - tenant_id
  - operator_user_id + operator_email (internal only)
  - action (SET_COMPLETE | RESET | RESET_ALL)
  - step_id(s)
  - reason
  - created_at
  - request_id / trace_id
- Audit record must be PII-safe for customers: do not store customer prompts/outputs; do not store raw API keys.
- Retention aligns with onboarding telemetry review (see Security review doc + ENG-5871): retain 180 days minimum for support debugging; align final value with Security.

### Console / Support UX (MVP)
- No customer-facing UI.
- Minimal internal UI surface:
  - Admin-only section inside the checklist drawer (feature-flagged to Redwood staff) OR a hidden "Support" tab.
  - Show current step state and whether state is derived vs overridden.
  - Provide actions with confirmation modal and reason field.
  - Show last 20 audit entries.

If Console UI is too heavy for the MVP timeline, ship API + runbook (curl examples) first; Support can use an internal script.

## API sketch (progress service)
Assuming checklist progress service from ENG-5813.

1) Create override
POST /internal/onboarding/tenants/{tenant_id}/checklist/overrides
Body:
- action: "SET_COMPLETE" | "RESET" | "RESET_ALL"
- step_ids: ["api_key_created", "first_successful_request", ...]
- reason: string
- external_ref: optional (e.g., "Jira:SUP-18510")

2) List audit events
GET /internal/onboarding/tenants/{tenant_id}/checklist/overrides?limit=50

3) Get computed checklist state (already exists)
GET /onboarding/tenants/{tenant_id}/checklist
Response should include, per step:
- state
- source: DERIVED | OVERRIDDEN
- overridden_by (optional; internal-only field)

## Implementation notes
- Store overrides in a dedicated table/collection keyed by (tenant_id, step_id). Use separate append-only audit log table for every change.
- Precedence rules:
  - If an override exists for a step, computed state = override.state
  - Reset removes override record (or sets override to NOT_STARTED with explicit action) but always writes an audit log entry
  - Derived state continues to update in background; when override is removed, step snaps back to derived value
- Rate-limit internal endpoints (avoid accidental loops in support scripts).
- Add internal metrics:
  - overrides_created_total by action
  - overrides_by_operator (low-cardinality; consider hashing user_id if needed)
  - overrides_per_tenant
- Ensure overrides do not break the monotonic transition fix in ENG-5866 (out-of-order events). We should run override logic after event ordering logic, not before.

## Test plan
- Unit tests:
  - RBAC gating for read/write
  - override precedence vs derived
  - reset behavior restores derived state
  - audit log immutability (no update in-place)
- Integration tests (staging):
  - create override, verify Console reads override source
  - reset override, verify state returns to derived
  - verify audit entries present and ordered

## Rollout
- Ship behind internal feature flag: onboarding_checklist_support_tools
- Enable for Support/CS staff only (group-based) in staging first
- Dogfood with Support using known tickets:
  - SUP-18421 (401 quickstart confusion) - verify we can unblock while docs fix ships
  - SUP-18488 (streaming disconnects) - verify step reset + re-test flow
- Add runbook section to Support playbook (Dev Patel owns)

## Links
- Linear: ENG-5813 (progress service), ENG-5814 (console checklist UI), ENG-5866 (race condition), ENG-5871 (privacy review)
- GitHub PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-28522-add-admin-override-for-checklist.json
- Support request: INT-3307

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Support Admin can mark one step COMPLETE for a tenant with a required reason; state is immediately reflected in checklist read API.
- [x] Support Admin can reset a step; state reverts to derived value when available.
- [x] All override actions generate an audit log entry and are queryable by tenant.
- [x] Operators without onboarding_checklist.override:write cannot perform overrides.
- [x] PII review completed/validated for stored fields (no prompts, no raw keys).
- [x] Runbook snippet (curl + when-to-use) posted for Support enablement.

## Notes / open questions
- Retention: confirm with Marcus Lin if audit log retention should match onboarding telemetry (proposed 180d) or broader internal audit retention.
- "Reset all" is high risk; keep internal-admin only and require a second confirmation.
- Consider adding an "override expires at" in a follow-up to prevent long-lived overrides masking regressions.
comments: 2025-03-10 (Chloe Martin): Creating this off Support request INT-3307. We need this before cohort rollout so Support isn’t blocked when state is wrong. Jada can you propose minimal API + audit schema; Console UI can be a follow-up if we’re tight on time.

2025-03-12 (Dev Patel): +1. Primary use cases are: (1) step stuck incomplete even after customer confirms they did it, (2) we need to reset step after we ask them to re-run quickstart. Must capture reason + ticket link so we don’t lose context.

2025-03-13 (Marcus Lin): Please ensure operator identity is internal-only and audit entries do not include any customer content. Also confirm retention and access control; this becomes sensitive since it implies ability to modify customer state.

2025-03-17 (Jada Williams): Drafted endpoints under /internal/onboarding/... with capability onboarding_checklist.override:write. Implementing dual storage: current override table + append-only audit. Question: should reset delete override row or write NOT_STARTED override? Leaning delete + audit entry to reduce confusion.
2025-03-19 (Dylan Brooks): Prefer delete-on-reset. For UI, at minimum we need read path so Support can see if something was overridden; actual buttons can be API-only in MVP.

2025-03-24 (Jada Williams): Implemented in PR-28522. Added computed field source=OVERRIDDEN/DERIVED per step in checklist response (internal fields gated). Added required reason validation and external_ref optional. Added tests for RBAC and precedence.
2025-03-27 (Sean Gallagher): Please add a metric for override volume and an alert if override count spikes post-release; could indicate eventing regression.
2025-04-02 (Chloe Martin): Merged + verified in staging with Support. Follow-up: add "override expires" as nice-to-have; tracking separately. Marking Done.
